Priority.asked.hint: Of your action, its result wanted on the screen at once: goes ahead of every other computation, never stopping the one running
Priority.background.hint: Of a change of the data: after your changes
Priority.markedWorks.hint: Over the works you marked or rated, a thousand at a time: after the background
Priority.otherWorks.hint: Over every other work, a thousand at a time by the expected grade: after every other computation, however long it waits
Priority.user.hint: Of a change of yours you do not wait to see: after what you wait for, ahead of the background
Reason.answer: an answer on a work's values

Reason.mark: a mark of a review or picture
Reason.models: the models are to learn from the works as they are now
Reason.notFitted: a page asked for an unfitted field
Reason.regrouped: works, series or authors put together or apart
Reason.searchFormat: the search index is of another format or not brought to every work

Reason.sweep: the sweep goes on from where it stopped
Reason.synonyms: a site named the synonyms of its tags
Reason.tagByText: an answer on a tag by the text
Reason.yielded: it gave way to a work you asked for, and goes on from where it stopped
Step.average: counting the average work of the graded
TaskQueue.hint: Every computation runs one at a time, whole, in the order asked. A planned one waits for the changes to settle, and newer changes put it off. How long one takes is told by the last run of the same work since the application started.
TaskQueue.inPortions: a portion at a time, from the best expected
TaskQueue.loadError: The queue could not be read: {{error}}
TaskQueue.state.FAILED.hint: Ended with an error: see the application's log
TaskQueue.state.FINISHED.hint: One of the last five done
TaskQueue.state.GIVEN_UP.hint: New data came while it ran: given up, done again on them — no error
TaskQueue.state.WAITING.hint: Waits its turn: first those your actions asked for, then the rest — each in the order asked
TaskQueue.title: Queue of computations
